name: com.reromanlee.eventaggregator
description: A minimal, allocation-free, type-keyed publish/subscribe event bus for Unity. Producers publish plain C# objects or structs; listeners subscribe per event type. No reflection, no code generation, no dependencies - two interfaces and one class.

samples.description: A composition root that owns the bus, plus a publisher and listeners showing the OnEnable/OnDisable pattern, a listener of two event types, and a chained event in the Event Debugger.
